flawed_step: Line 0005 states a false factorization: its right-hand side equals a^{p(p-1)}-1, not a^{p(p-1)-1}.
counterexample: Take a=26 and p=5. The premise used in line 0003 holds because 26^4 ≡ 1 (mod 25). But line 0005 claims 26^19=(26^4-1)((26^4)^4+(26^4)^3+(26^4)^2+26^4+1). The right-hand side telescopes to 26^20-1, which is not 26^19.
assessment_summary: The induction relies on the incorrect identity in line 0005, so the proof is invalid as written.
